verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a programmatic API with access tokens for controlling it alongside orchestrators like Airflow, which implies triggering syncs. It also offers a Connection Timeline with downloadable logs and errors, plus webhook notifications for failure events. Its documented MCP server is aimed at connecting agents to data through Airbyte Agents, not at operating pipelines, and the evidence never shows API endpoints for job status, failure diagnosis or re-runs. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for sync/job status and re-triggering, programmatic (non-UI) access to failure logs, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent doing this loop.
